description: The full MatchCV pipeline: analyze the job description, structure the resume, then rewrite it for that role with must-have keywords worked in and bullets rewritten. Returns the tailored resume JSON, an ATS score, and a public preview link the user can open and download as PDF. This is the heaviest tool — it uses one generation credit plus the parse and JD-analysis credits, so run it once the user has settled on a target job.

resumeText.description: The candidate's current resume as plain text.

targetLanguage.description: "en" forces English output; "original" (default) keeps the resume's own language.

templateId.description: Resume template for the preview page. Defaults to classic-ats.

name: tailor_resume
title: Generate a resume tailored to a specific job
